task.title: P6-084: Carry the next redirect through Google sign-in (web callback and Tauri poll)
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 5 — Missing capability). Original id: P6-084. Size: M. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/auth.md.

**Google sign-in does not honor `?next`** — `account.rs:372-428` builds the callback and error URLs from the origin only, and no `next`/state parameter is read or threaded anywhere. Carry the post-auth destination through the web OAuth callback (state param) and the Tauri poll path.
